correctness.rationale: Independently generated labeled edges by scanning the cyclic triples 110 and 101 and verified full directed reachability in both directions on 4, 10, 20, 35 and 56 states. For a separate symbolic calculation, represent states by cyclic vacancy gaps g₀,g₁,g₂ after ordered particles. A hop transfers one vacancy from positive gᵢ to gᵢ₋₁ at dimensionless rate 1_{gᵢ₋₁=0}+q1_{gᵢ=1}, including both channels and jumps staying in the same quotient orbit. On the gap quotient the checked stationary weight is the cyclic orbit multiplicity times q to the number of zero gaps. With escape rate r, generator L and stationary mean J, solve Lh=J−r in a fixed-state gauge. The corrected count Q_t−Jt+h(X_t)−h(X_0) is a martingale, whose stationary squared jump rate is the sum of π(g)w(g,g′)[1+h(g′)−h(g)]². The boundary correction is bounded, so this yields the long-time variance rate. It reproduced all five rational J and F pairs exactly, verifying positivity of each mean derivative and of F−1 for n≥5 (with F₄=1). Exact root tests and sign brackets confirm strict F₅ monotonicity and exactly one interior global minimum on each of n=6,7,8 in the three advertised intervals. With at least one vacancy, a gap of one enables a follower hop and a cyclic run of zero gaps ending before a positive gap enables a leader hop; all gaps ≥2 are frozen and first possible at n=9. Differences between different bond counts stay bounded by particle conservation, so an individual bond has asymptotic mean αJ/n and Fano ratio F/n, rather than the displayed total-count ratio. The frozen checker was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: The classification concerns total successful hops in the complete three-particle active sectors for n=4,…,8. It does not describe the active communicating classes of larger rings, finite-time Fano ratios, or a thermodynamic limit.

originality.rationale: The process, stationary law, and stationary mean-current analysis are prior, as are tilted-generator and Poisson methods. The supported distinct result is the exact finite integrated activity variance-to-mean classification over the complete three-particle active range, including the change from monotonic/Poisson behavior to unique interior minima. value.rationale: Fixing three particles and examining the whole irreducible active range is a natural, exhaustive cutoff rather than selecting sizes with a desired effect. A finite-size transition from Poisson or monotone activity noise to a unique nonzero optimum, while mean throughput remains increasing, separates time correlations from stationary transport. Exact signs and thresholds are useful small-system benchmarks for constrained transport, independently of a large-ring theory.
residual_risks: There is no claim that noise curves retain this form in larger active classes, at other densities or for single-bond counts as a Poisson comparison.
